name: ocd-support
description: Keep project decisions, compare options and prepare a handoff.

interface.longDescription: Keep project decisions, compare options and prepare a handoff. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Record a project decision; Compare options using your weighted criteria; Prepare a project handoff checklist. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. General personal and project organization. Uses only supplied task, project or schedule data. No healthcare records, clinical scoring, treatment, background reminders or external account access.
defaultPrompt: Help me record a project decision.
Help me compare options using your weighted criteria.

prompts: Help me record a project decision.
Help me compare options using your weighted criteria.
Help me prepare a project handoff checklist.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Project Pages: Decision Log workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Record a project decision. Reproducible inputs: {"project":"Reading nook","decision":"Use the existing oak shelf","rationale":"It fits the measured alcove and avoids a new purchase.","owner":"Project lead","next_step":"Measure the fixing positions."}
positive.prompt: Help me record a project decision with these supplied values: {"project":"Reading nook","decision":"Use the existing oak shelf","rationale":"It fits the measured alcove and avoids a new purchase.","owner":"Project lead","next_step":"Measure the fixing positions."}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses project_pages_decision_record with the supplied inputs. Returns {"record":{"project":"Reading nook","decision":"Use the existing oak shelf","rationale":"It fits the measured alcove and avoids a new purchase.","owner":"Project lead","next_step":"Measure the fixing positions."},"checklist":[{"action":"Measure the fixing positions.","owner":"Project lead","done":false}]}. Shows the actual brief result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare options using your weighted criteria. Reproducible inputs: {"criteria":[{"name":"Fits the space","weight":3},{"name":"Easy to assemble","weight":2}],"options":[{"name":"Shelf A","scores":"9, 6"},{"name":"Shelf B","scores":"7, 9"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare options using your weighted criteria with these supplied values: {"criteria":[{"name":"Fits the space","weight":3},{"name":"Easy to assemble","weight":2}],"options":[{"name":"Shelf A","scores":"9, 6"},{"name":"Shelf B","scores":"7, 9"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses project_pages_option_scorecard with the supplied inputs. Returns {"criteria":[{"name":"Fits the space","weight":3},{"name":"Easy to assemble","weight":2}],"ranked":[{"name":"Shelf A","scores":[9,6],"weighted_score":7.8},{"name":"Shelf B","scores":[7,9],"weighted_score":7.8}],"note":"Scores and weights are supplied judgments, not verified product ratings."}. Shows the actual scorecard result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Prepare a project handoff checklist. Reproducible inputs: {"project":"Reading nook","items":[{"action":"Confirm shelf measurements","owner":"Project lead","status":"done"},{"action":"Check fixing materials","owner":"Installer","status":"waiting"}],"notes":["Use the measurements recorded in the project document."]}
positive.prompt: Help me prepare a project handoff checklist with these supplied values: {"project":"Reading nook","items":[{"action":"Confirm shelf measurements","owner":"Project lead","status":"done"},{"action":"Check fixing materials","owner":"Installer","status":"waiting"}],"notes":["Use the measurements recorded in the project document."]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses project_pages_project_handoff with the supplied inputs. Returns {"project":"Reading nook","items":[{"action":"Confirm shelf measurements","owner":"Project lead","status":"done"},{"action":"Check fixing materials","owner":"Installer","status":"waiting"}],"notes":["Use the measurements recorded in the project document."],"open_items":[{"action":"Check fixing materials","owner":"Installer","status":"waiting"}],"completed_count":1}. review.commerce_description: No payments, orders, purchases or external account changes.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.0: Replaces former healthcare workflows with nonmedical personal/project planning operations. Compact native host task surfaces. Five tools, labeled examples, versioned documents and recoverable validation.
